files.desc: Verifies the ten quiz-score standard deviation example (mean, variance, and standard deviation) using Python's statistics module.
Computes mean, median, variance, standard deviation, and quartiles for the car dealership data set using Python's statistics module.

covers.desc: Be able to use summation notation to write and evaluate sums of data values.
Be able to compute the mean and median and choose the appropriate one based on resistance to outliers and distribution shape.
Be able to compute and interpret range, interquartile range, variance, and standard deviation.
Be able to relate a distribution's shape and outliers to its mean, median, and spread, and predict how shifting or scaling data affects summary statistics.
Be able to compute and interpret z-scores, percentiles, and quartiles to locate a value within a distribution.
